signals: stack trace points to property access after input boundary
likely_causes: missing validation or contract mismatch
evidence_to_collect: first frame plus input shape and caller
experiments: feed invalid and valid boundary cases
verification: regression test rejects malformed input

signals: unhandledRejection or uncaughtException near async task
likely_causes: promise ownership missing or error rethrow lost
evidence_to_collect: process logs with request or job id
experiments: await task and observe rejection owner
common_wrong_fix: add a process handler that swallows error
verification: test expected failure and process health

symptom: UI shows old value after mutation
signals: source read is new but rendered selector/cache remains old
likely_causes: duplicated state or missing invalidation
evidence_to_collect: source snapshot cache key event order
experiments: read after mutation with cache bypass
common_wrong_fix: force global refresh after every mutation
verification: mutation then read regression

signals: state changes on remount or key change
likely_causes: unstable identity or effect mirrors props
evidence_to_collect: mount key props and state transition trace
experiments: remove key or delay remount to isolate owner
common_wrong_fix: copy props into state and sync in effect
verification: focused interaction test

signals: callback fires after screen or controller disposal
likely_causes: uncancelled listener or async completion
evidence_to_collect: route timeline disposal callback and native log
experiments: navigate away at each await boundary
common_wrong_fix: add null guards only at visible caller
verification: repeat navigation regression

symptom: duplicate event handling grows per visit
signals: listener count rises after enter leave
likely_causes: subscription not removed or effect dependency repeats
evidence_to_collect: listener registration count and cleanup trace
experiments: visit screen twice with event probe
verification: listener count returns to baseline

signals: request IDs finish out of order
likely_causes: completion order used as freshness
evidence_to_collect: request timeline IDs sequence and state writes
experiments: delay first request and release second first
verification: older result is ignored by version or cancellation

signals: duplicate request IDs or two subscriptions
likely_causes: retry plus re-entry or effect double-run
evidence_to_collect: caller count request IDs and lifecycle
experiments: trigger rapid action and single action
verification: one durable side effect exists

symptom: request hangs until UI is unusable
signals: no timeout or cancellation event
likely_causes: transport promise never settles or queue is blocked
evidence_to_collect: timing logs and abort signal state
experiments: disconnect or hold server response
verification: timeout produces actionable retry state

signals: cancel event followed by success/error update
likely_causes: abort ignored or stale closure
evidence_to_collect: abort propagation and post-cancel writes
experiments: cancel during request and inspect writes
verification: disposed owner has no state write

signals: offline DNS TLS timeout or connection error
likely_causes: transport environment or endpoint issue
evidence_to_collect: method host class status elapsed and error code
experiments: run same request from known network and local host
verification: transport failure is classified separately

signals: HTTP status with valid response body
likely_causes: server contract or auth policy failure
evidence_to_collect: status headers redacted body class and request ID
experiments: replay safe request and inspect server route
verification: expected status maps to user recovery

symptom: request succeeds but data is unusable
signals: 2xx response fails decoder or fields missing
likely_causes: response schema drift or wrong content type
evidence_to_collect: content type status bounded payload shape
experiments: save redacted fixture and run decoder
verification: decoder rejects bad fixture clearly

signals: two refresh calls or expired token ordering
likely_causes: refresh race clock skew or retry ordering
evidence_to_collect: redacted token identity request timeline expiry
experiments: serialize refresh and compare concurrent behavior
verification: one refresh and correct retry behavior

symptom: unrelated users or queries share result
signals: cache keys omit tenant filter locale or parameters
likely_causes: under-specified key or normalization collision
evidence_to_collect: print hashed key components and query inputs
experiments: add one distinguishing parameter and compare keys
verification: distinct inputs produce distinct entries

symptom: updated source is hidden by cached read
signals: write path omits affected key/version
likely_causes: invalid invalidation ownership
evidence_to_collect: source version key and mutation event
experiments: disable cache then compare targeted invalidation
verification: affected read changes while unrelated cache survives

signals: one table updated while related write fails
likely_causes: transaction boundary split or wrong connection
evidence_to_collect: DB state before after and transaction logs
experiments: fail second write and inspect rollback
common_wrong_fix: catch and continue with partial state
verification: atomic state is restored

signals: unique or foreign key constraint absent or bypassed
likely_causes: application-only validation race
evidence_to_collect: live schema and concurrent insert trace
experiments: run two writers against real DB
verification: constraint or idempotency prevents duplicate

signals: query count scales with item count
likely_causes: query in loop or lazy relation
evidence_to_collect: query count timings and row count
experiments: compare one item and 100 items
verification: query count follows intended bound

signals: render count and JS/UI thread work rise
likely_causes: unstable inputs effect loop or broad state owner
evidence_to_collect: profiler flame and render count
experiments: freeze unrelated state and profile again
verification: frame budget and render cause improve

signals: hydration warning or first-paint replacement
likely_causes: environment-dependent render or client-only value
evidence_to_collect: server HTML client value and route phase
experiments: replace time/random/browser read with stable input
verification: stable first render then client update

symptom: back or deep link lands incorrectly
signals: route params missing or stack differs by entry path
likely_causes: non-serializable params or split navigation ownership
evidence_to_collect: entry URL route state and navigation events
experiments: launch cold and warm via deep link
verification: all supported entry paths resolve correct screen

symptom: memory rises after repeated list visits
signals: heap or native image/resource baseline never returns
likely_causes: listener image cache or retained closure
evidence_to_collect: heap snapshots and resource/listener counts
experiments: repeat visit with bounded dataset
common_wrong_fix: raise memory limit or force GC only
verification: baseline returns within known tolerance

signals: cache entries and decoded images increase with usage
likely_causes: unbounded cache or missing eviction
evidence_to_collect: cache size hit rate and entry age
experiments: load varied keys beyond expected working set
verification: bounded eviction preserves correctness

signals: long synchronous task on main or JS thread
likely_causes: parsing loop serialization or crypto on hot path
evidence_to_collect: profile task duration and thread
experiments: move one computation off path or chunk it
verification: interaction stays within measured budget

signals: first tool error names JDK SDK compiler or plugin mismatch
likely_causes: toolchain version incompatibility
evidence_to_collect: exact first error and resolved versions
experiments: run supported version matrix
verification: same target builds with recorded toolchain

symptom: only one package or platform fails
signals: lockfile has duplicated incompatible versions
likely_causes: peer native or transitive mismatch
evidence_to_collect: package tree lockfile and affected importer
experiments: resolve one dependency edge and rerun target
verification: resolved graph and target build are coherent

signals: environment or clean checkout differs
likely_causes: missing secret tool version path or test order
evidence_to_collect: CI command env names cache state and artifact
experiments: run clean temp checkout or matching container
verification: CI reproduces or difference is documented

symptom: works locally but fails in target env
signals: missing or wrong typed config value
likely_causes: configuration precedence or secret injection
evidence_to_collect: variable names only source and effective non-secret metadata
experiments: run with variable absent and valid placeholder
verification: missing config fails safely and valid config works

symptom: release app crashes in native path
signals: device log symbolicated frame or signal
likely_causes: platform lifecycle permission ABI or native module mismatch
evidence_to_collect: crash log symbols device OS build and native versions
experiments: reproduce on affected device/variant with symbols
common_wrong_fix: catch native error in JS/Dart only
verification: affected release path no longer crashes

symptom: Docker service has wrong environment or exposed port
signals: container sees missing config or host cannot reach mapped service port
likely_causes: Compose environment precedence service versus host port mapping or wrong network binding
evidence_to_collect: effective container environment docker compose config port mapping and health endpoint
experiments: render the resolved Compose config and test service to service and host paths
common_wrong_fix: rebuild image repeatedly without checking runtime config
verification: Docker service starts with validated config and both expected network paths work

symptom: Tauri frontend command fails or is denied at the IPC boundary
signals: invoke error or capability rejection occurs between frontend and Rust command
likely_causes: command not registered capability permission missing or serialized payload mismatch
evidence_to_collect: frontend invoke payload Rust command registration capability files and desktop logs
experiments: call the command with a minimal payload then verify registration capabilities and serialized fields
common_wrong_fix: catch the error only in the frontend or disable permission checks
verification: frontend and Rust command agree on registration permissions payload and failure handling

symptom: Android release build or app fails after R8 minification
signals: release-only missing class method or obfuscated Logcat stack appears for a variant
likely_causes: missing keep rule reflection generated or native class and variant-specific shrinker configuration
evidence_to_collect: Gradle variant R8 warnings mapping.txt missing symbols and comparable debug release behavior
experiments: compare the affected release variant with debug inspect mapping and add the narrow keep rule required by evidence
common_wrong_fix: disable minification globally or ship without mapping files
verification: the affected release variant builds and reproduces with symbolicated evidence when needed
